reviewedItems.item: Commerce product, price, inventory, and fulfillment authoring
reviewedItems.requestedAction: Document data dependencies, creation lanes, publication, search projection, fulfillment evidence, and browser proof.
sourceFindings: 2026-10-09 LOCAL_SIMULATION re-review: DefaultFulfillmentItemSimulationService requires package-derived LOCAL class, exact selected-environment allowlist, strict enabled values and matching Promotion mode/service before and after context canonicalization. Its detached SKU-sorted context adds the merchant-observed positive Store revision and exact SIM: handle; no persistence, inventory, carrier or physical-receipt work occurs in this evaluator.

Raw simulation proof is explicitly simulated:true, verified:false, immutable:false, SIMULATED / ITEM_SIMULATION / SIMULATED_ITEMS, sourceRevision:0 and no deliveredAt. SHA-256 of ITEM_SIMULATION_V1 plus canonical context provides deterministic correlation only, not authentication, immutable storage or durable physical-delivery replay protection.

Promotion ItemBenefit rechecks actual simulator admission and mode across the evaluator await and requires exact original tenant/vendor/issuer/buyer/coupon/Product/campaign/revision/outlet/target, bundle, reference and source integrity. It refuses promoted verified/immutable flags, real delivery status/stage, deliveredAt and changed outlet revision. Its bound benefit retains simulated/unverified ITEM tags but does not project the raw immutable field or infer money.

Digital ITEM provider reuses the exact pricedAuthority object through validateCoupon, preserving private issuer admission. Existing canonical confirmation phases, current signed human/Profile/Store/consent, original vendor-owned encrypted stock, target, benefit binding and protected coordination receipt are unchanged. ITEM skips monetary COMMIT. Confirmation/queue and original pending/completed receipt inspection retain simulated:true, deliveryVerified:false, evidenceMode:LOCAL_SIMULATION.

Digital MERCHANT_RECEIPT generic DELIVERED status and deliveredAt derived from original marker.confirmedAt are workflow coordination metadata, not Fulfillment simulator proof, physical delivery or carrier authentication. Only the simulator is non-mutating; the existing merchant journey can claim/redeem disposable original records. Original exact receipt/key replay and failed/ambiguous readback remain authoritative.

The real DefaultFulfillmentItemDeliveryEvidenceService remains available:false and always refuses absent authenticated original Shipment allocation receipt admission. VERIFIED mode and independently qualified real receipt requirements are unchanged. Human-approved LOCAL simulation does not establish real delivery, installed persistence, current native acceptance or monetary qualification.

Already-redeemed benefit inverses are intentionally disabled in the approved scope: MerchantScope.resolveBudgetRequest admits COMMIT only, including when tested with a genuine in-flight COMMIT object. No RELEASE caller, budget replenishment, used-coupon refund or automatic compensation is supplied. Existing unused-purchase and original-sale DIGITAL_OWNERSHIP refunds remain independent.

Four canonical owner articles were re-read against those sources: Promotion owns retained ITEM rights/mode and disabled inverse; Fulfillment owns selection, exact SIM grammar/nonimmutable evidence and real-source refusal; Digital owns exact private dispatch, protected receipt/recovery and public labels; the Fulfillment source map references these owners. Existing central authoring/publication/search/browser-proof anchors remain accurate and unchanged.

Focused source contracts pass 200/200; owning CMS references/composition tests pass 16/16. All three optional documentation releases pass canonical validation; docs:check and validate pass 176 pages. The separate inspected project test passes 2/2, including all 29 unchanged exact ITEM promises and native-vs-Docker selection. These checks exercise source/configuration with isolated owner ports, not installed/native/browser or real delivery acceptance.
Copilot ITEM preparation/mutation remains unsupported; read-only consumer projection work is a separate source review, not authority to execute that path.

Final frozen SIM-handle review: only Digital Merchant confirm and original receipt inspection generic receipt character classes now admit @, preserving their existing bounds and all original key/outlet/marker/staff/receipt checks. Fulfillment still enforces the stricter canonical ^SIM:[A-Za-z0-9_.:@-]{1,115}$ grammar; this does not admit a wrong prefix, slash, whitespace or oversized simulation. Actual integrated private MerchantScope fixture now validates, confirms, redeems, replays, inspects the original receipt and reads queue with SIM:original@outlet, retaining issuer authority, vendor storage, original encrypted stock and unverified labels. Its 55/55 source cases pass. No auth/policy, real delivery qualification, monetary or inverse authority changed.
